name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan
description: A voluntary contributory pension scheme for eligible unorganised workers. The official scheme portal should be checked for current enrolment and terms.
benefits: Assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 from age 60, subject to scheme conditions
Government makes a matching contribution to the subscriber’s contribution

otherConditions: Not covered by NPS, Employees’ State Insurance Scheme, or Employees’ Provident Fund Scheme

contribution: Monthly contribution ranges from ₹55 to ₹200 depending on entry age, matched equally by the Central Government; verify the current contribution chart on the official portal.
documents: Savings bank or Jan Dhan account with IFSC
applicationSteps: Enrol through a Common Service Centre or the official scheme portal.
Confirm eligibility and the contribution amount using the official age-based chart.
Provide requested documents and consent through the authorised channel.
verificationStatus: Verified against Ministry of Labour & Employment Annual Report 2024–25; confirm current terms at enrolment.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
description: A renewable one-year personal accident insurance scheme for eligible bank or post office account holders.
benefits: ₹2 lakh for accidental death or specified total permanent disability
₹1 lakh for specified partial permanent disability

otherConditions: Individual account holder of a participating bank or post office

contribution: ₹20 per year per member according to the official FAQ; verify current premium before joining.
documents: Participating bank or post office account
Enrolment consent through the account provider
applicationSteps: Contact a participating bank or post office where you hold an account.
Review the policy terms and provide consent for auto-debit.
Keep the enrolment acknowledgement and verify renewal terms.
verificationStatus: Verified against official FAQ; confirm renewal premium and terms.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
description: A renewable one-year term life insurance scheme offered through participating banks and post offices.
benefits: ₹2 lakh life cover for death due to any cause, subject to policy terms

otherConditions: Individual account holder of a participating bank or post office
A 30-day lien period applies to specified first-time or re-joining cover

contribution: ₹436 per year in the official rules/FAQ reviewed; pro-rata terms and premium can change, verify before joining.
documents: Participating bank or post office account
Enrolment consent through the account provider
applicationSteps: Contact a participating bank or post office where you hold an account.
Review the current policy terms, exclusions and premium.
Provide consent and retain the acknowledgement.
verificationStatus: Verified against official rules/FAQ; premium is subject to revision.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: A voluntary, periodic contribution pension scheme administered by PFRDA and implemented through banks and the Department of Posts.
benefits: Choice of guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000 after age 60
Spouse pension and nominee pension wealth as specified by scheme rules

otherConditions: Indian citizen with a savings bank or post office savings account
A person who is or has been an income-tax payer is not eligible to newly join from 1 October 2022

contribution: Depends on joining age, chosen pension slab and payment frequency; use the official PFRDA contribution table.
documents: Savings bank or post office savings account
Nominee and spouse details as applicable; confirm current bank requirements
applicationSteps: Contact the bank or post office that holds your savings account, or use an authorised online channel.
Choose a pension slab and contribution frequency after reviewing the official chart.
Confirm auto-debit and nomination details with the provider.
verificationStatus: Verified against PFRDA scheme page and FAQ.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY: Senior Citizens 70+
description: PM-JAY has a dedicated expansion for all people aged 70 and above, regardless of socio-economic status. Eligibility and enrolment must be confirmed through the official beneficiary channel.
benefits: Health cover up to ₹5 lakh for eligible senior citizens aged 70 and above, subject to scheme rules

otherConditions: Aadhaar-based e-KYC is required for enrolment

contribution: No premium amount is specified for beneficiaries in the NHA FAQ reviewed; confirm current process on official channels.
documents: Aadhaar for age verification and e-KYC, as stated by NHA
applicationSteps: Check the official beneficiary portal or Ayushman App.
Complete the official identity verification and enrolment steps.
Confirm empanelled hospital and coverage details before treatment.
verificationStatus: Verified against National Health Authority senior-citizen FAQ; this record covers the 70+ expansion only.

name: Karnataka BOCW Board Pension Scheme
description: A pension scheme listed for registered construction workers under Karnataka’s Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. Benefit amount and current operating requirements need confirmation with the Board.
benefits: Monthly pension benefit for qualifying registered construction workers; amount needs verification

otherConditions: Registration as a beneficiary with the Karnataka BOCW Welfare Board
Portal listing indicates at least three years as a beneficiary; verify current rule directly with the Board

applicationSteps: Use the Karnataka BOCW Welfare Board portal or contact the Labour Department to confirm current eligibility and process.
Confirm required documents, benefit amount and application status directly with the Board.
verificationStatus: Needs verification: scheme is listed in official state scheme directory; detailed current rules, benefit and documents not confirmed.
